**Paris Get‑away: A 7‑Day Itinerary (Mid‑April)** *(Adjust dates and activities to fit your schedule and interests.)* | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **1 – Arrival & Orientation** | • Arrive at Charles de Gaulle (or Orly).
• Take the RER B or a taxi to your hotel in the 7th arrondissement (near Eiffel Tower).
• Check‑in, freshen up. | • Walk along the Seine to the **Eiffel Tower**; climb to the second floor for sunset views.
• Grab a light lunch at **Café Constant** (famous for its croissants). | • Dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Michelin‑starred, panoramic city view).
• Night stroll across the **Pont Alexandre III**. | | **2 – Classic Landmarks** | • Breakfast at **Ladurée** on Champs‑Élysées.
• Visit the **Arc de Triomphe**; climb to the top for a view of the avenue. | • Walk down the Champs‑Élysées to the **Grand Palais**.
• Explore the **Louvre Museum** (reserve tickets online to skip the line). | • Dinner at **Le Comptoir du Relais** (classic French bistro).
• Optional: Seine river cruise (night cruise offers illuminated landmarks). | | **3 – Artistic Immersion** | • Breakfast at **Café Marly** overlooking the Louvre courtyard.
• Visit **Musée d’Orsay** (Impressionist masterpieces). | • Lunch at **Le Café du Musée d’Orsay**.
• Stroll through the **Tuileries Garden** to the **Place de la Concorde**. | • Dinner at **Septime** (modern French cuisine, reservations required).
• Attend a show at the **Opéra Garnier** (check schedule). | | **4 – Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur** | • Breakfast at **Le Pain Quotidien** near Sacré‑Coeur.
• Climb to the **Basilica of Sacré‑Coeur**; enjoy panoramic city views. | • Explore **Montmartre**: Place du Tertre, **Espace Dalí**, and the **Moulin Rouge** backdrop.
• Lunch at **La Maison Rose**. | • Dinner at **Le Coq Rico** (roasted chicken specialty).
• Optional: live jazz at **Le Caveau de la Huchette**. | | **5 – Day Trip to Versailles** | • Early breakfast at the hotel.
• Take the RER C to **Versailles Château** (tickets online). | • Tour the Hall of Mirrors, Royal Apartments, and Gardens.
• Picnic lunch in the gardens (pick up baguette, cheese, wine from a local market). | • Return to Paris.
• Light dinner at **L’Avant‑Garde** (French tapas). | | **6 – Modern & Shopping** | • Breakfast at **Café Kitsuné** in the Palais‑Royal.
• Visit the **Centre Pompidou** (modern art). | • Lunch at **Le Georges** (restaurant on the Pompidou roof).
• Shopping in the **Marais** district: concept stores, vintage shops, and **Merci** boutique. | • Dinner at **Restaurant Guy Savoy** (Michelin‑starred, book well in advance).
• Evening walk along the **Seine** to see the **Notre‑Dame** illuminated. | | **7 – Departure** | • Pack, check‑out.
• Quick visit to **Père Lachaise Cemetery** if time allows. | • Last‑minute souvenir shopping at **Galeries Lafayette**. | • Head to the airport via RER B or taxi. | --- ### Practical Tips | Topic | Recommendation | |-------|----------------| | **Accommodation** | *Hotel Le Meurice* (luxury), *Hôtel Henriette* (boutique), or *Hotel Ekta* (budget‑friendly). All located near major attractions. | | **Transportation** | Purchase a **Paris Visite pass** (valid for 2–5 days) covering metro, buses, and RER within zones 1–3. For day trips, consider the **SNCF** train to Versailles. | | **Dining** | Reserve tables at Michelin‑starred restaurants 2–3 weeks ahead. Try local specialties: croissants, escargot, coq au vin, macarons. | | **Tickets** | Book Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, and Versailles tickets online to avoid queues. | | **Weather** | Mid‑April averages 12–18 °C. Pack layers, a light rain jacket, and comfortable walking shoes. | | **Language** | Basic French phrases help; most staff speak English. | | **Safety** | Keep an eye on belongings in crowded areas. Use official taxis or rideshare apps. | --- ### Suggested Packing List | Category | Items | |----------|-------| | Clothing | Comfortable walking shoes, light jacket, sweater, jeans/skirts, dress for fine dining, hat or scarf. | | Essentials | Passport, travel insurance, credit cards, phone charger, power adapter (Type E/F). | | Toiletries | Toothbrush, toothpaste, deodorant, skincare, makeup, sunscreen. | | Miscellaneous | Reusable water bottle, small backpack, guidebook or offline map app, notebook. | --- Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like more details—such as specific restaurant reservations, ticket booking links, or a customized budget—just let me know.
